title: Adobe announces a $25B stock repurchase program through April 30, 2030; Adobe shares have fallen around 30% so far this year (Zaheer Kachwala/Reuters)
summary: Zaheer Kachwala / Reuters: Adobe announces a $25B stock repurchase program through April 30, 2030; Adobe shares have fallen around 30% so far this year — Adobe (ADBE.O) on Tuesday said its board of directors has approved a new $25 billion stock repurchase program through April 30, 2030, sending its shares up around 2% in extended trading.
